notes.title: Version 1.3
notes.content:
Version 1.3
Changes

 Fixed a bug that made it impossible to interact with the castle

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.content:
Version 1.2
Fixed: 

 The ability to interact with some items multiple times has been fixed.
 Fixed doors during fire.
 Fixed a gap in windows on the street.
 Fixed items not being removed from inventory after use.
 Edited visual novel text.

Added: 

 Added description of interaction with the door.
 Added various pointers to help with orientation in space and searching for items.

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:
Changes
[olist]
 The run time of the flashlight has been increased.
 A new sound has been added to better understand the operation of the light in the house.
[/olist]
Reviews
Leave feedback and we will be glad to fix all possible defects as quickly as possible.

Enjoy the game
